setup: Buildable net10.0-windows nested partial S009Outer.InnerForm has its code-behind and InitializeComponent declarations split across two files and contains one Button.
actionLog: Open S009NestedForm.cs with the WinForms Designer
expected: Observe whether Visual Studio supports a nested Form as a design root without assuming an open or refusal outcome.

refusalResult.visualStudioMessage: The designer could not be shown for this file because none of the classes within it can be designed.

reviewOutcome: Visual Studio displayed its fail-closed designer error page instead of a canvas. The enclosing S009Outer and nested InnerForm were recognized as source, but no class in the file was considered designable; source and Designer bytes remained identical.
